title: Vibrant Crunchy Italian Chuck Roast Trofie
description: A floral and crunchy Italian dish featuring chuck roast, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot and served with trofie pasta, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chuck roast with sea salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium high heat.
Sear the chuck roast until browned on all sides, then remove from the pot.
Add the garlic, rosemary, and thyme to the pot and cook until fragrant.
Add the trofie pasta to the pot and cook until lightly toasted.
Return the chuck roast to the pot and add the lemon zest and pine nuts.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the chuck roast for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Serve the chuck roast with the trofie pasta and sauce, garnished with additional rosemary and lemon zest if desired.
